subject: FinServCorp RFI: SOC 2 control mapping and artifact delivery
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: FinServCorp RFI intake + owners (SOC 2 / SIG items)

Team —

FinServCorp opened an RFI focused on SOC 2 / SIG controls. I reviewed their question set and they want: a control mapping (SIG->our SOC 2 controls), sample artifacts for access provisioning, logging/monitoring, and encryption, and a sanitized audit log export. They asked for items by EOD next Friday (Feb 27) to hit their procurement cycle.

Proposed split:
- Monica: produce the sanitized audit log export (Kibana CSV) + retention summary + network diagram.
- Dev: pull the infra config snippets (IAM policies, KMS policy snapshot) and a short note on key management lifecycle.
- I will assemble the control mapping spreadsheet and produce a short cover note mapping SIG sections to our SOC 2 criteria and evidence filenames.

Please confirm ownership and any blockers today. If needed, we can call FinServCorp for a short clarification — they prefer email but are available for a 30-min call.

Hannah
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@finserv.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@finserv.com>, procurement@finserv.com
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: FinServCorp RFI intake + owners (SOC 2 / SIG items)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick note and proposed owners. A couple clarifications so we can scope our review correctly:

1) Control mapping: Can you map Redwood controls to the SIG v2.1 items (confidentiality, integrity, availability) and identify whether the evidence demonstrates design, operating effectiveness, or both?
2) Artifacts: For initial review we need: a) provisioning/deprovisioning runbook or screenshot of user directory showing recent creation/deactivation events (sanitized), b) a 24-hour slice of audit logs from your primary logging cluster (Kibana CSV fine, sanitized), c) KMS policy snapshot and a short description of key rotation cadence.
3) SOC 2 report: if available, please state whether you will provide an unredacted SOC 2 report under NDA or a redacted summary; if neither, point to the certification date and scope.
4) Subprocessors: we need a current list of subprocessors and whether they have SOC 2 or equivalent.

Target: can you deliver the mapping + artifacts by Feb 27? If a hard blocker, let us know which items will be delayed.

Regards,
Rajiv
Head of Vendor Risk
FinServCorp

---
Note: external request; do not include customer PII in exported logs.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@finserv.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@finserv.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:48:05 -0800
Subject: Re: FinServCorp RFI intake + owners (SOC 2 / SIG items) — attachments

Rajiv / Anna —

Thanks for the specifics. Attached is an initial package and a control mapping. Notes below:

Attachments included (sanitized):
- redwood_soc2_control_mapping.xlsx — mapping of SIG items to our SOC 2 control IDs, and column for evidence files + whether design/operating_effectiveness.
- kibana_audit_log_export_20260220.csv — 24-hour sanitized slice (user IDs hashed; IPs truncated to /24).
- kms_policy_snapshot_20260223.txt — current IAM/KMS policy exported from config.
- network_diagram_v2.pdf — high-level network and trust boundaries (no customer IPs).

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a Type II SOC 2 audit, coverage through 2025-09-30. We can provide the redacted report now; an unredacted copy can be shared under a mutual NDA.
- Subprocessors: see tab "Subprocessors" in the control mapping spreadsheet; all subprocessors and their attestation status are listed.

Open items for us to confirm before final delivery:
- Monica: confirm retention window and point to the audit log index used for export so we can cite retention policy in the cover note.
- Dev: confirm exact KMS rotation cadence and whether the envelope keys are rotated monthly or quarterly.

If this looks good, we'll produce a consolidated bundle by Feb 27 with a short cover letter mapping each artifact to the RFI question.

Hannah

---
Attachments: redwood_soc2_control_mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet), kibana_audit_log_export_20260220.csv (csv), kms_policy_snapshot_20260223.txt (text), network_diagram_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@finserv.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:20:37 -0800
Subject: Re: FinServCorp RFI intake + owners (SOC 2 / SIG items) — log retention notes

Rajiv / team —

Following up on Hannah's package: a few clarifications on logs and retention.

- Source: the attached CSV is the Kibana export from index redwood-logs-application-*, covering 2026-02-20 00:00 to 2026-02-20 23:59 UTC.
- Retention: application logs are retained for 90 days in the hot cluster, then archived for 365 days. We cited this in the "Evidence" column of the mapping sheet.
- Sanitization: we replaced usernames with hashed identifiers and truncated IPs to protect customer data. If FinServCorp needs more granularity for a control test, we can provide an access-controlled view but that requires an SCP (signed confidentiality addendum).
- Network diagram: attached "network_diagram_v2.pdf" illustrates our VPC layout and where logging agents run.

Happy to join a short call to walk through artifacts.

Monica
Sr. Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: network_diagram_v2.pdf (pdf)

Redwood Inference
